assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for an existing Godot top-down pixel-art roguelike. Crisp hand-painted pixel clusters, dark outlines, warm readable highlights, restrained detail, orthographic 3/4 overhead view, never isometric diamond tiles. No text, no labels, no grid lines, no watermark. Create one square 1024x1024 transparent PNG with an EXACT 2-column by 2-row grid of equal 512x512 cells. Each cell contains ONE full-body sprite of the SAME original Japanese adult sumo wrestler boss Yamada: huge broad heavy round body, bare chest, black traditional topknot, indigo mawashi wrestling belt with gold cords, barefoot, fierce eyebrows, charming intimidating stylized videogame proportions. Same face, costume, scale and feet baseline; face toward viewer and slightly right. Top left: low sumo guard idle, both open palms raised. Top right: forceful shuffling forward palm thrust. Bottom left: shiko stomp, one leg lifted high and arms spread. Bottom right: low powerful shoulder charge pose. All body parts fit inside their own cell with 36px transparent padding. Real transparent alpha outside character, no floor, no shadows, no scene, no effects, no checkerboard.

environment_alpha_cleanup: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: supplied environment sprite atlas. Make a production transparent sprite sheet: remove ALL off-white/white/gray background, checkerboard haze and grid divider lines surrounding the props. Set those background pixels to alpha=0 completely. KEEP EVERY SPRITE exactly in its present cell, preserve every detail, color, material, size, grid layout and position. KEEP the TOP LEFT square floor tile COMPLETELY OPAQUE and unchanged; do not remove pale colors inside the wall, wood, flowers, paper panels, lantern, or other object interiors. The other seven cells must have fully TRANSPARENT exterior around each individual object, including between objects. No new shadows, no background, no checkerboard pattern, no white matte. Output real RGBA PNG. This is alpha cleanup only.
